case.message: Compare Apple annual revenue and net income before and after November 10, 2023. Explain whether management outlook passages can actually be tested using the retrieved financial metrics.

data.response:
# Apple Annual Revenue and Net Income Investigation

**Insufficient evidence**

AAPL revenue for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $391.035 billion [Ed02ca420fd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), up from $383.285 billion for 2023-09-30 [E7d33aa1f4c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL net income for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $93.736 billion [Eec3db25eff](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $96.995 billion for 2023-09-30 [Edec67dea46](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). AAPL cash PP&E purchases for the fiscal period ended 2024-09-28 was $9.447 billion [E85a32507cc](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), down from $10.959 billion for 2023-09-30 [E0163df5389](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html).

## What was knowable then

Before November 10, 2023, Apple filed its annual report for the fiscal year ended September 24, 2022, reporting revenue of 394,328,000,000 USD and net income of 99,803,000,000 USD [E55dc45a4ec](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [E7dc41b50d4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html). Subsequently, Apple filed its annual report for the fiscal year ended September 30, 2023, on November 3, 2023, disclosing revenue of 383,285,000,000 USD and net income of 96,995,000,000 USD [E7d33aa1f4c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) [Edec67dea46](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html). No specific management outlook claims or forward-looking statements from the relevant window were retrieved under the supported search tags [E6821590ed0].

## What happened later

After November 10, 2023, Apple reported results for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, showing annual revenue of 391,035,000,000 USD and net income of 93,736,000,000 USD [Ed02ca420fd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html) [Eec3db25eff](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html). Comparing annual figures across periods indicates that revenue decreased from fiscal 2022 to fiscal 2023 before increasing in fiscal 2024 [E55dc45a4ec](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [E7d33aa1f4c](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) [Ed02ca420fd](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html), while net income decreased across both subsequent annual periods from 99,803,000,000 USD to 96,995,000,000 USD and then to 93,736,000,000 USD [E7dc41b50d4](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019322000108/0000320193-22-000108-index.html) [Edec67dea46](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019323000106/0000320193-23-000106-index.html) [Eec3db25eff](https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/320193/000032019324000123/0000320193-24-000123-index.html).

## The peer test

Only AAPL was selected. Add a peer company to compare results.

## Cross-examination

Management outlook passages cannot be tested because no matching records of management forecasts or claims were retrieved around the November 10, 2023 as-of date [E6821590ed0]. Consequently, the observed financial changes cannot be used to verify unretrieved statements or management intent.

## Limits

- No matching records found in the date-bounded source for AAPL claims around November 10, 2023.
- Missing peer company coverage within the retrieved scope to execute a comparative peer test.
- Missing as-of vintage macroeconomic data and known-then historical source filings to evaluate AAPL performance without hindsight contamination.

sections.title: What was knowable then

sections.title: What happened later
sections.text: After November 10, 2023, Apple reported results for the fiscal year ended September 28, 2024, showing annual revenue of 391,035,000,000 USD and net income of 93,736,000,000 USD [Ed02ca420fd] [Eec3db25eff]. Comparing annual figures across periods indicates that revenue decreased from fiscal 2022 to fiscal 2023 before increasing in fiscal 2024 [E55dc45a4ec] [E7d33aa1f4c] [Ed02ca420fd], while net income decreased across both subsequent annual periods from 99,803,000,000 USD to 96,995,000,000 USD and then to 93,736,000,000 USD [E7dc41b50d4] [Edec67dea46] [Eec3db25eff].
